dedupe_keys.name: schneider electric ecostruxure it data centre infrastructure management dcim software

description: EcoStruxure IT is Schneider Electric's software for data centre infrastructure management. The product page describes it as a complete, vendor-agnostic DCIM platform for monitoring, management and modelling of hybrid IT infrastructure, from large data centres to distributed and edge sites, with the aims of better visibility, reliability and planning. It collects power, cooling and environmental readings from equipment of many makers, tracks assets and capacity, and models the effect of changes on power and cooling before they are made. Coverage: any data centre or edge site the user connects; global. Format and access: commercial software, offered as cloud services and on-premise tools, with a licence from Schneider Electric. Caveats: proprietary, so models and data stay with the operator; the product page is a marketing page, and module names change over time; vendor-agnostic support depends on device protocols. Simulation uses: capacity and failure scenario planning for data centre power and cooling, and a monitoring source for digital twins of facilities. Related records: platform-nlyte-dcim, platform-sunbird-dcim and platform-hyperview-cloud-dcim are comparable DCIM platforms; data-eu-data-centre-energy-performance-database gives facility energy data at the European level.
